Laws.Name: Tax Cut
Laws.Description: Lower income tax to stimulate consumption and investment.

Laws.Name: Tax Hike
Laws.Description: Raise taxes to reduce the budget deficit at the cost of growth.

Laws.Name: General Mobilization
Laws.Description: Mobilize reserves: more manpower and war support, lower stability.

Laws.Name: Surveillance Act
Laws.Description: Expand domestic surveillance: less corruption and crime, fewer civil liberties.

Laws.Name: Non-Alignment
Laws.Description: Stay out of military blocs: lower world tension, weaker guarantees.

Laws.Name: Universal Healthcare
Laws.Description: State-funded healthcare: longer life expectancy, higher deficit.

Laws.Name: Carbon Tax
Laws.Description: Tax carbon emissions: better environment, slight growth cost.

Laws.Name: Nuclear Energy Program
Laws.Description: Invest in nuclear power: more energy and modest growth.

Laws.Name: Conscription
Laws.Description: Mandatory military service: larger manpower pool, lower war support.
